sources.selection: Residential SFH/MFH SE.01–SE.05, all states and zones. Equivalent SFH source variants share values; source_variants retains both codes and source_locators selects the first exact workbook cell. Door values are outside current envelope model scope.

boundary_comparison.reason: The MF SE.01 representative has a completely conditioned basement. Its BETSI ground-inclusive ISO 13370 floor/wall U-values already include ground effects, but TABULA subsequently applies Cellar resistance and temperature corrections. The adjusted observations are retained for traceability, not used to accept nominal material-layer U-values.
